title: Export Field Catalog
description: Per-coordinate catalog of exportable parcel fields offered in the data-plane export field picker (PARAPP-2029). Authored in Yuli only; delivered to core.config__export_field_catalog. Each descriptor's `expr`/`join` are CONTROL-PLANE-ONLY SQL — delivered so the data plane can build its export query, but stripped from the client-facing projection.

active.description: Controls the delivery table active flag. Defaults to true.

fields.description: Keyed map of stable field id -> field descriptor. The whole catalog for this coordinate.

propertyNames.description: Stable field id: snake_case, must start with a lowercase letter or underscore.

label.description: Column header shown in the export.

default.description: Pre-checked in the picker / used when no explicit field selection is given.

expr.description: SQL select expression. CONTROL-PLANE-ONLY — never sent to the client.

join.description: SQL join clause. CONTROL-PLANE-ONLY — never sent to the client.

fieldFormat.description: How the field's raw value is formatted for display. `type` maps 1:1 to the parcell-ui formatter functions.

type.description: Formatter to apply. Must be one of the supported functions.

precision.description: Fraction digits / rounding precision (used by num / shortNumber / round).

unit.description: Suffix appended to the formatted value, e.g. "ac", "sq ft".
